sloka: तदेतत् सर्वमातिष्ठ वीर्यं भीमपराक्रम ।न हि ते सर्वभूतेषु दृश्यते सदृशो बली ।। ६.६२.२२ ।।
transliteration: tadetat sarvamātiṣṭha vīryaṁ bhīmaparākrama ।na hi te sarvabhūteṣu dṛśyate sadṛśo balī ।। 6.62.22 ।।

translations.english: "O Brother of fierce valour! Get up. I have not seen anyone stronger than you among all beings."
